_scenario_note: 実績OPM（FY2023-FY2026）: 9.04 → **4.29** → 7.47 → **9.94%**。min 4.29 / p25 6.67 / med 8.25 / p75 9.26 / max 9.94%。直近が観測窓の最高で中央値を上回るため Base 到達OPM =（直近実績 9.94 + p75 9.26）/2 = **9.60%**（実質横ばい）。Upside は max(実績p75 9.26, 直近+1.0pt = 10.94) = 10.94%。Downside 1 は min(p25 6.67, 直近 9.94) = 6.67%。Downside 2 は実績トラフ **4.29%**（FY2024/3 実績、直近と大きく乖離した実在の谷）を起点に売上 −8% を重ねた。■FY2024/3 の落ち込みは事業構造改革費用によるもので、**わずか2年前に半分以下のマージンを記録している**点に注意。■**恒等式の扱い**: テンプレは OP = 売上 − COGS − SGA で計算するため、**COGS% を実績水準に固定し SGA% = 100% − COGS% − 目標OPM で逆算**した。本モデルの SGA 行は「販管費 ± その他営業損益」を表す。COGS% は直近実績 64.4% に固定した。既存銘柄からの流用なし。
investment_thesis: Fujitsu has narrowed to domestic IT services and Uvance while shedding hardware, and the operating margin has recovered to the top of its four-year range; the shares trade at {per} earnings and {pb} book.
The balance sheet is net cash with interest-bearing debt at just four percent of revenue, so the {wacc} discount rate is the cost of equity with no leverage assumed.

At {price} the shares are valued below the diversified-electronics and IT-services peer median on EV/EBITDA; a base case that holds the current margin supports {target_price}, or {upside_pct} from here.
key_risks: The operating margin was 4.29% just two years ago on restructuring charges, so the recovery behind {target_price} is only two years old and the second downside case returns to that level.
Revenue has fallen for three consecutive years on divestitures, and the base case assumes the shrinking stops — which the reported top line has not yet shown.
Reported net income in the latest year far exceeded operating income, so the {per} the market pays is measured against an earnings base that includes items the operating result does not.
